nodes.description: The ER stress-relieving bile acid corrected the immune defects of the knock-in mice and reversed the phenotype the mutants acquired after pet store mouse exposure. This is a mouse result. No patient has been reported to receive it for this disorder, no dose or schedule is established, and it is recorded here because it identifies the mechanistic node that is druggable, not because it is a recommended therapy.
